about.subtitle: WHO IS DINO PÉO?
about.title: A Bit About Me
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Trần Duy Phát, a dedicated developer based in Vietnam. I'm passionate about deciphering challenging problems and creating exceptional digital experiences that live on the web.

As I've grown as a developer, I've focused on mastering modern front-end technologies. I've contributed to various projects, collaborating with teams to build robust, maintainable applications with a focus on clean, understandable code.

Through my academic journey and self-study, I've gained a solid understanding of web development concepts. I dedicate significant time to applying these principles to real-world scenarios, constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible in the browser.
When I'm not building, learning, or exploring new UI trends, you can catch me watching football matches or seeking inspiration for my next creative project.

projects.subtitle: MY PROJECTS
projects.title: Some Things I Built
projects.description: I like to stay busy and always have a project in the works. Take a look at some of the applications I've have built

1.title: Portfolio
1.description: A high-performance personal portfolio built with React 19 and Framer Motion. Focused on creating a unique 'System UI' experience with optimized animations and full localization support.

2.title: E-commerce Website
2.description: Modern, responsive e-commerce web application built with React, Tailwind, and Firebase, featuring real-time data management and user authentication.

3.title: Restaurant Website
3.description: Elegant restaurant website providing a seamless online ordering experience and menu presentation. Built with React and Vite.

4.title: Weather Forecast
4.description: Comprehensive weather forecast application providing real-time updates and detailed atmospheric data with a sleek UI.

5.title: Dino Movies
5.description: A simple web application to discover movie information, built with React + Vite and deployed on Vercel.

6.title: DinoStore
6.description: A modern online store built with React + Vite, focusing on a smooth shopping experience and efficient cart management.

7.title: DinoBot Discord
7.description: Versatile Discord Bot written in Node.js to assist in server management and community interaction.

8.title: ShopFSTYLE
8.description: Full-featured fashion e-commerce website developed as a graduation project, featuring product management, inventory tracking, and order processing. Built with PHP and MySQL.

9.title: Pokédex Mobile
9.description: A mobile application for exploring the Pokémon world using PokéAPI, built with React Native and TypeScript.

10.title: LinkSnap - URL & Bio
10.description: A professional link management platform combining a powerful URL shortener with a modern Bio Page builder. Features real-time analytics with interactive charts, custom QR code generation, and seamless Google OAuth integration.
